model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for several variants of the SepLLM and StrmLLM models, alongside a “Vanilla” baseline. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” spans from 0 to 140,000 with major tick marks every 20,000 iterations and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with major ticks every 0.1 unit, also on a linear scale. Six distinct lines are plotted: “Vanilla” (purple, solid line) begins near 3.35 and steadily declines to approximately 2.51; “StrmLLM (n=64)” (blue, solid line) starts around 3.35 and decreases to about 2.62; “SepLLM (n=64)” (orange, solid line) begins near 3.35 and falls to roughly 2.55; “SepLLM (n=64, H)” (green, solid line) starts at ~3.35 and ends near 2.53; “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” (red, solid line) begins at ~3.35 and converges to ~2.52; and “SepLLM (n=128)” (dark blue, solid line) starts at ~3.35 and settles around 2.60. All lines exhibit a rapid initial drop in loss followed by a slower, steady decline toward convergence.
